report.title: Research Foundry Knowledge MCP — Next Actions & AOS Integration
report.subject: research-foundry-knowledge-mcp-v1
report.scope_note: Companion to the feature-completion report (index.html). The Knowledge MCP shipped P1–P6 (squash 1376e85); this report is the actionable roadmap — every row carries a copyable agent handoff (command, absolute repo, existence-checked paths, grep-verified requirement IDs, re-entry trigger, and a paste-ready prompt).
report.constraints: Research Foundry: Markdown/YAML is canonical and the claim ledger is authority. The Knowledge MCP is read-only, local/loopback-only, and schema-aligned-only — NOT OpenAI/ChatGPT compatible and with no remote/HTTPS transport. It must never write, hold provider credentials, or import the Search Router/Operator registries. RF main is local-only: do not push to origin without explicit approval. Agent-writable paths must never mint CLEARED_*/counsel_approved/attested rights values.

vitals.measured_by: count of items[] in this manifest

items.title: Integrate the Knowledge MCP into the full AOS
items.note: RF has a read-only knowledge plane, but AOS subsystems (op, Hermes, node agents, MeatyWiki) don't yet know to use it. Deploy rf-knowledge-mcp on rocket-fedora alongside existing services, register it in SERVICES.md and tool/model routing, and decide the loopback/stdio binding.

handoff.prompt: Route integrating rf-knowledge-mcp into the AOS: deploy it on rocket-fedora as a systemd --user unit (ensure the serve extra per KMCP-F1), register it in SERVICES.md and tool routing so op/Hermes/node agents can query RF knowledge. Keep it loopback/stdio only; no remote exposure.

items.title: Add a skill/agent to make the Knowledge MCP usable in workflows
items.note: Eight tools + a CLI exist, but agents won't reach for them without guidance. Consider an rf-knowledge skill (when to search vs fetch, RF vs core tools, ID/URL semantics) and/or a knowledge-lookup subagent, or extend the research-foundry skill, so the plane is actually used.

handoff.prompt: Route deciding how to enable the Knowledge MCP for agents: weigh a new rf-knowledge skill vs a knowledge-lookup subagent vs extending the research-foundry skill. The deliverable must teach when to use search/fetch/rf_* and the eight tools. Read-only, local, schema-aligned-only.

items.title: KMCP-F1 — decouple auth types from research_foundry.api.* so the process drops the serve extra
items.note: Importing knowledge_mcp.process pulls fastapi via two module-level imports in knowledge_access.py routed through api/__init__.py's unconditional probe. The forbidden set stays absent (verified) — this is dependency hygiene, not an AC violation.

handoff.trigger: When AuthIdentity / resolve_workspace_isolation_active are relocated out of the research_foundry.api.* package.
handoff.prompt: Scope decoupling RF auth types (AuthIdentity, resolve_workspace_isolation_active) out of research_foundry.api.* into a neutral module with back-compat re-exports, so rf-knowledge-mcp imports under the mcp extra alone. Verify via the transitive-closure test that fastapi leaves sys.modules. Do not change auth behavior.

items.title: KMCP-DF-1 — remote Streamable HTTP + OAuth transport design
items.note: Remote identity/session/threat design (auth, rate-limit, revocation, workspace + transport review) required before any non-loopback transport.

handoff.trigger: Auth, rate-limit, revocation, workspace, and transport review accepted.
handoff.prompt: Promote the remote-transport shaping spec into a plan: design Streamable HTTP + OAuth identity/session/threat model for rf-knowledge-mcp. Keep local stdio unchanged and schema-aligned-only. Nothing remote ships until the transport review is accepted.

items.title: KMCP-DF-2 — canonical public HTTPS resource URLs ADR
items.note: Canonical URL ADR, host ownership, redirect/version policy, and live reachability — required before URLs can be non-loopback/canonical.

handoff.trigger: Canonical URL ADR, host ownership, redirect/version policy, and live reachability resolved.
handoff.prompt: Promote the canonical-resource-URL shaping spec: author the ADR for the public HTTPS resource namespace, host ownership, redirect/version policy, and reachability. Until it lands, keep all Knowledge MCP URLs loopback-only and explicitly non-canonical.

items.title: KMCP-DF-3 — remote cache isolation threat model
items.note: Partition, invalidation, timing, backup, and deletion threat model to prevent a remote cache leaking tenant membership/timing.

handoff.trigger: Partition, invalidation, timing, backup, and deletion threat model passes.
handoff.prompt: Promote the remote-cache-isolation shaping spec into a threat model: partitioning, invalidation, timing side-channels, backup, and deletion for any remote cache. Gate on it before enabling remote caching; local v1 has no shared cache.

items.title: KMCP-DF-4 — shared / vector / graph retrieval
items.note: Shared indexes are outside the RAL private lexical v1; needs separate evidence/quality evaluation and isolation approval.

handoff.trigger: Separate evidence/quality evaluation and isolation approval complete.
handoff.prompt: Promote the shared-indexes shaping spec: evaluate shared/vector/graph retrieval quality and isolation for the assertion ledger, distinct from the private lexical v1. Requires its own evidence + isolation approval before implementation.

items.title: KMCP-DF-5 — Operator MCP (mutation + cost-bearing tools)
items.note: Mutations and cost-bearing tools require a different, stricter policy posture — a separate Operator MCP plan, gated on stable read IDs.

handoff.trigger: Operator MCP plan approved and read IDs stable.
handoff.prompt: Advance the Operator MCP PRD: design the mutation + cost-bearing tool surface under its own stricter policy posture, separate from the read-only Knowledge MCP. Do not add any mutator to rf-knowledge-mcp; reads must stay write-free.

items.title: Make rf-knowledge-mcp reachable to local agents (on-node deploy + client registration)
items.note: Register the stdio server in agent client configs and, if desired, install it on the agentic node. Ensure the serve extra is present (KMCP-F1). Config/human action — no single agent command.

handoff.prompt: human decision — register rf-knowledge-mcp (stdio) in the relevant MCP client config(s) per docs/user/knowledge-mcp.md, ensuring the serve extra is installed (KMCP-F1). Optionally deploy to rocket-fedora. Keep it loopback/stdio only; no remote exposure.

items.title: Push local main to origin (gated)
items.note: 1376e85 (and the ERI commit above it, e76784b) are local-only. Pushing is an explicit, owner-gated action per RF convention; required before any origin-pulling deploy.

handoff.prompt: human decision — decide whether to push local main (1376e85 + e76784b) to origin. Per RF git-workflow, push is a separate gated action; confirm the data-plane split and unrelated tree dirt before pushing.
